## 入学条件 {#admissions}

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>申请身份限制：</strong>课程页明确本预科入口不对EU／国际申请者开放。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-8f52d5c3abaae6">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>A-level及GCSE要求：</strong>Excluded subjects General studies, citizenship studies, critical thinking. GCSEs 英语及maths：grade 4 (C) 或 above (或 equivalent level 2 qualification). We do not accept Functional Skills 英语及Functional Skills 数学.</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-8f52d5c3abaae6">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>IB要求：</strong>IB score 24 分 总分 或 5,4,4：three HL certificates</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-8f52d5c3abaae6">官方依据</a></p>
